## What changed and why

## Definition of done
- [ ] Code reviewed by someone other than the author
- [ ] Tests added or updated (pgTAP for database rules, JUnit for Java) and passing in CI
- [ ] Golden/parity tests pass where the capability has them
- [ ] No trigger, constraint or guard weakened to make a test pass (or an ADR explains why)
- [ ] Spec / ADR updated if behaviour or a decision changed
- [ ] No production or client data in code, tests or fixtures
- [ ] Tracker updated (story status, tests)
